taxon.native_range: Tropical and subtropical Asia to western Pacific

human_evidence.trial: 100 adults, 8-week randomized trial, standardized leaf-rich aerial extract 250 mg daily; improved perceived stress and insomnia symptom scores versus placebo, not proof of treating disease
human_evidence.review: 2017 systematic review of 24 heterogeneous human studies

chemistry.note: Volatile oil varies greatly by chemotype and sampled plant part; do not generalize concentrations.
chemistry.methyl_eugenol_rich: South India: hydrodistilled leaf oil reported 75.3% methyl eugenol in sampled oil.
chemistry.australian_oil: Camphor 31.5%, 1,8-cineole 18.9%, eugenol 13.8% of reported oil volatiles.

tradition.ayurveda: Traditional rasa/guna/virya/vipaka descriptors vary across sources; primary pharmacopoeia passage not verified.
tradition.vaishnava: Publicly documented sacred use in devotion to Vishnu/Krishna, not medical evidence.

safety.note: Pregnancy, blood clotting, thyroid, glucose, medication interactions require preparation-specific caution; clinical safety unknown for long-term use.
